items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: My brother, which is Henry Foster, playing baritone.

ctx.x: Not then. No. Any other musicians that you can think of in the home at that time or a little later?
Uh. Well, Rene Lice Armstrong. Red Happy. My brother, which is Henry Foster, playing baritone. And, uh, Old Folks. Jim O'Brown.
Who was the other fellow you said, Old?
